name: meta-ads-agent
description: Operate Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads through Meta's official Ads MCP: account audits, validated campaign plans, paused-by-default builds, placement previews, reporting, and diagnosis. Independent project, not affiliated with Meta.

metadata.note: The Meta Ads MCP server is deliberately NOT bundled here. Meta's OAuth client id is the Meta App ID of an app the user controls, so any value shipped in this manifest would be wrong for everyone. Connect it once with the command in docs/getting-started/connect-meta-mcp.md; integrations/claude/mcp.json is a copy-paste template. See docs/architecture/adr/ADR-006-mcp-connection-is-user-owned.md.
metadata.optionalCli: meta-ads-agent, installed separately with uv or pip. Needed for campaign builds: it drafts and validates the plan, turns it into the MCP's arguments, and records what was built. Also the report arithmetic. Meta's MCP itself needs no CLI and no credentials.
metadata.safetyModel: Everything is created PAUSED, or as a draft. Activation, publishing, budget changes on live objects and deletion require explicit user approval. A PreToolUse hook asks before those Meta MCP calls and refuses to create a campaign, ad set or ad that is not PAUSED (ADR-011); it needs python3 on PATH, and does not see shell commands.
